Great! After **Nd3 Bg5**, Black has **Nxe5**, winning the knight because it's now attacked twice and defended once. Nd3 is clearly the best move—it's a fork attacking the bishop and knight.

**Best move:** Nd3

**Main line:** Nd3 Nxd3 (or Bg5 Nxe5) Qxd5

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent places a piece aggressively (here Ne5), look for knight moves to its strong outpost squares. Nd3 forks the bishop on f4 and the knight on e5—you win material either way. Your opponent must choose which piece to lose. This teaches you to spot central squares where your knight attacks multiple pieces at once.
